quickAnswer.title: A three-way QC decision: keep, clarify or request a return
paragraphs: Compare the order’s selected option with the warehouse photos before judging appearance. Confirm item identity, size or measurements, quantity, included pieces and visible condition. Mark each check as matching, mismatched or not shown. A missing view is an evidence gap; it is not proof that the item passes inspection.

Keep an item when the relevant evidence meets your requirements. Request a precise extra photo or measurement when one unresolved detail changes the decision. For a visible mismatch, contact support on the order promptly and confirm seller acceptance, deadlines and return costs before arranging international shipment.
